create_coref_ace_reader: create a CorefACEReader instance to read coreference clusters from an ACE dataset with a given max span width
read_coref_ace_dataset: read coreference annotations from an ACE dataset file and yield AllenNLP Instance objects per document
canonicalize_clusters: canonicalize coreference clusters by merging clusters that contain identical spans
convert_sentences_to_instance: convert a list of tokenized sentences and gold clusters into an AllenNLP Instance with spans and span labels
normalize_word: normalize ACE words by stripping leading slashes from punctuation tokens like /./ and /?/
